name: bot-banana
description: BotBanana — Discord Bot Framework modular para economia, gamificação, auto-roles, mini-games e IA.

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),cp=require('child_process');function walk(d){for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d)){const p=path.join(d,f),s=fs.statSync(p);if(s.isDirectory())walk(p);else if(p.endsWith('.js'))cp.execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',p],{stdio:'inherit'});}}walk('scripts');"
